universal-everything--ultrasound-vision-.why_en: Drawing becomes composing: every stroke you paint in the air turns into a sound that plays from where you drew it.
universal-everything--ultrasound-vision-.why_zh: 绘画就是作曲：你在空中画下的每一笔都变成声音，并从你落笔的位置响起。

botao-amber-hu--echovision.why_en: Put on the mask and call out: your voice lights up the room in echoes, so you see like a bat.
botao-amber-hu--echovision.why_zh: 戴上面具发出声音，回声把空间照亮，你就像蝙蝠一样“听见”了空间。

ian-curtis--x170377.why_en: A picture frame on the wall is really a window: look into it and another 3D world sits behind the wall.
ian-curtis--x170377.why_zh: 墙上的画框其实是一扇窗，往里看，墙后藏着另一个立体世界。

stijn-spanhove--ad-block.why_en: An ad blocker for the street: billboards in front of you simply get covered up.
stijn-spanhove--ad-block.why_zh: 给街道装上广告拦截：眼前的广告牌直接被遮掉。

universal-everything--someone-random-mir.why_en: A mirror that never shows you, only someone else moving the way you move.
universal-everything--someone-random-mir.why_zh: 一面从不照出你自己的镜子，镜中永远是另一个人在跟着你动。

aidan-wolf--hand-frame-photos.why_en: Frame a shot with your fingers and the photo stays hanging at that spot for the next person to find.
aidan-wolf--hand-frame-photos.why_zh: 用手指比个取景框就能拍照，照片留在拍摄的地方，等下一个人来发现。

torin-blankensmith--io-brush-recreation.why_en: Dip your hand into the real world to pick up its color and texture, then paint with it.
torin-blankensmith--io-brush-recreation.why_zh: 把手伸进现实里蘸一下颜色和质感，再拿它来作画。

1024-architecture--1d-arcade.why_en: A whole arcade game squeezed into a single line of light, and you still understand it at a glance.
1024-architecture--1d-arcade.why_zh: 整个街机游戏被压缩进一条光线里，一眼就能看懂怎么玩。

botao-amber-hu--feltsight.why_en: Borrow a star-nosed mole's sense: you feel the space around you through your fingertips instead of seeing it.
botao-amber-hu--feltsight.why_zh: 借用星鼻鼹鼠的感官：用指尖去触摸周围的空间，而不是用眼睛去看。

torin-blankensmith--echoes.why_en: Every pose you strike is answered by the most similar pose of someone who stood there before you.
torin-blankensmith--echoes.why_zh: 你摆出的每个姿势，都会召唤出之前站在这里的人做过的最相似的姿势。

jason-orlosky--head-tracked-subtitles.why_en: Real life gets subtitles, shown beneath whoever is speaking, the way films caption dialogue.
jason-orlosky--head-tracked-subtitles.why_zh: 给现实生活加字幕，像电影字幕那样出现在说话的人下方。

kiyoshi-kiyokawa--ar-co2-visualization.why_en: The air you share becomes visible: invisible CO2 turns into a colored cloud filling the stale corners of the room.
kiyoshi-kiyokawa--ar-co2-visualization.why_zh: 让共享的空气看得见：无形的二氧化碳变成彩色的云，填满房间里不通风的角落。

figmin-xr--the-floor-is-lava.why_en: The childhood game made literal: the floor really turns to lava and only the furniture is safe.
figmin-xr--the-floor-is-lava.why_zh: 把童年游戏变成真的：地板真的变成岩浆，只有家具上才安全。

jun-nishida--electrical-head-actuation.why_en: Instead of drawing an arrow to show you where to look, the interface turns your head for you.
jun-nishida--electrical-head-actuation.why_zh: 界面不再画箭头提示你往哪看，而是直接帮你把头转过去。

keiichi-matsuda--reality-channels.why_en: Flip through the city like TV channels: the same street, re-skinned with each switch.
keiichi-matsuda--reality-channels.why_zh: 像换电视频道一样切换城市：同一条街，每换一次就换一身皮肤。

russ-maschmeyer--reverse-ar.why_en: AR turned inside out: the product stays real and the room around it becomes virtual.
russ-maschmeyer--reverse-ar.why_zh: 把增强现实反过来用：商品是真实的，周围的房间却是虚拟的。

sander-veenhof--distant-hand.why_en: Your hand stretches far out in AR so you can touch things across the room.
sander-veenhof--distant-hand.why_zh: 你的手在增强现实中伸得很长，可以碰到房间另一头的东西。

shunichi-kasahara--morphing-identity.why_en: Your face slowly melts into the face of the person sitting across from you, live.
shunichi-kasahara--morphing-identity.why_zh: 你的脸实时地慢慢变成对面那个人的脸。

shunichi-kasahara--parallel-ping-pong.why_en: One mind, two bodies: a single person plays two ping-pong matches at the same time.
shunichi-kasahara--parallel-ping-pong.why_zh: 一个意识，两个身体：一个人同时打两场乒乓球。

daniel-rozin--cmy-shadows-mirror.why_en: Three colored shadows overlap on the wall and mix into a colored reflection of you.
daniel-rozin--cmy-shadows-mirror.why_zh: 青、品红、黄三色影子在墙上叠加，混合成你的彩色镜像。

paris-ar-studio--paris-1924.why_en: Hold up your phone and the street you are standing on goes back exactly one hundred years.
paris-ar-studio--paris-1924.why_zh: 举起手机，你脚下的这条街就回到了整整一百年前。

anrick-bregman--project-revival.why_en: Stand before a broken artefact and see it whole again, exactly where it sits.
anrick-bregman--project-revival.why_zh: 站在残破的文物前，就在它所在的位置看到它完整的样子。

takashi-yoshinaga--mr-door-quest3.why_en: Open the real door in your home and a virtual world is waiting on the other side.
takashi-yoshinaga--mr-door-quest3.why_zh: 打开家里真实的门，门后是一个虚拟世界。

ryo-suzuki--sketched-reality.why_en: A spring you draw on paper can bounce a real robot, and the robot can push your drawings back.
ryo-suzuki--sketched-reality.why_zh: 纸上画的弹簧能把真实的小机器人弹开，机器人也能推动画出来的东西。

aidan-wolf--touch-grass-lens.why_en: The internet joke taken literally: the lens checks that you really touched grass and gives you proof.
aidan-wolf--touch-grass-lens.why_zh: 把网络梗当真：这个滤镜确认你真的摸到了草，并给你出去过的证明。

daniel-beauchamp--spatial-vacuuming.why_en: While you vacuum, the floor you have cleaned gets painted over, so the missed spots stand out.
daniel-beauchamp--spatial-vacuuming.why_zh: 吸尘时，吸过的地面被实时涂上颜色，漏掉的角落一眼就看出来。

stijn-spanhove--micro-art.why_en: Point at a rock or leaf and see the imagined microscopic world living inside it.
stijn-spanhove--micro-art.why_zh: 对准一块石头或一片叶子，就能看到它内部想象出来的微观世界。

lucas-rizzotto--music-with-clothes.why_en: Your outfit becomes an instrument: tap different parts of your clothes to play music.
lucas-rizzotto--music-with-clothes.why_zh: 衣服变成乐器：拍打衣服的不同部位就能演奏音乐。

sean-follmer--audio-personas.why_en: Everyone carries a personal sound around their body, so you hear who is nearby before you look.
sean-follmer--audio-personas.why_zh: 每个人身上都带着一段专属声音，你还没转头就能听出谁在附近。

jason-orlosky--ar-air-conditioning.why_en: Invisible airflow becomes visible, and you steer the air conditioner by grabbing the stream itself.
jason-orlosky--ar-air-conditioning.why_zh: 让看不见的气流显形，直接抓住气流就能控制空调吹的方向。

universal-everything--chameleon.why_en: A digital creature on the street copies how passers-by move and look, like a chameleon.
universal-everything--chameleon.why_zh: 街头的数字生物像变色龙一样，模仿路人的动作和样子。

botao-amber-hu--touchport.why_en: A handshake and a pull is all it takes to merge two people's separate mixed realities into one.
botao-amber-hu--touchport.why_zh: 握手再一拉，两个人各自的混合现实就合成了一个共享空间。

kitasenju-design--super-slit-scan.why_en: Time is smeared across the frame, so moving people turn into stretched sculptures of their own motion.
kitasenju-design--super-slit-scan.why_zh: 时间被铺展在画面上，移动的人变成被拉伸的、由自身动作构成的雕塑。
